Table of parameters

Source: R/table.R
pub_params_table.Rd

Makes a table (see pub_table()) that lists params, e.g. for a parameter section in a report. By default it shows their labels, values and descriptions. Values are shown as toString(param_value(p)) (date-times in UTC). A param_group() is shown as "<label>: <value>" of its members that have a value, e.g. "Lower: 1, Upper: 2". An empty value (length 0, all NA or blank) is shown as na.

Usage

pub_params_table(
  params,
  caption = NULL,
  columns = c(label = "Parameter", value = "Value", description = "Description"),
  na = ""
)

Arguments

params

Named list of params, e.g. from pub_get_params(). Plain values are shown with their name as label.

caption

character(1) table caption or NULL.

columns

Named character vector: field -> column header. The fields are "name" (the param name), "value" or any param attribute such as "label", "description" or "area".

na

character(1) text shown for empty values.

Value

A huxtable.

See also

pub_get_params()

Examples

params <- param_config(
    alpha = numeric_param(0.05, label = "Alpha", description = "Level"),
    trans = choice_param("log", c("none", "log"), label = "Transformation"),
    limits = param_group(
        list(
            lower = numeric_param(1, label = "Lower"),
            upper = numeric_param(NA_real_, label = "Upper")
        ),
        label = "Limits"
    ),
    note = param("", label = "Note")
)
ht <- pub_params_table(params, caption = "Parameters", na = "-")
pub_cell_text(ht)
#>      [,1]             [,2]       [,3]            
#> [1,] "Parameter"      "Value"    "Description"   
#> [2,] "Alpha"          "0.05"     "Level"         
#> [3,] "Transformation" "log"      "Transformation"
#> [4,] "Limits"         "Lower: 1" "Limits"        
#> [5,] "Note"           "-"        "Note"          

pub_params_table(params, columns = c(name = "Name", value = "Value")) |>
    pub_cell_text()
#>      [,1]     [,2]      
#> [1,] "Name"   "Value"   
#> [2,] "alpha"  "0.05"    
#> [3,] "trans"  "log"     
#> [4,] "limits" "Lower: 1"
#> [5,] "note"   ""
